title: Count Smaller Elements With Opposite Parity
summary: Given an integer array nums, compute the score for each index.
statement: Given an integer array nums, compute the score for each index. The score for index i is the count of indices j where j > i, nums[j] < nums[i], and nums[i] and nums[j] have opposite parities. Return an array where each element is the score of the corresponding index.
constraints: nums is a nonempty integer array.
For each i, count later j with nums[j]<nums[i] and opposite parity.
reference_solution:
def count_smaller_opposite_parity(nums):
    values=sorted(set(nums));tree=[[0]*(len(values)+1) for _ in range(2)]
    def add(parity,index):
        index+=1
        while index<len(tree[parity]):tree[parity][index]+=1;index+=index&-index
    def prefix(parity,index):
        total=0
        while index:total+=tree[parity][index];index-=index&-index
        return total
    from bisect import bisect_left
    answer=[0]*len(nums)
    for i in range(len(nums)-1,-1,-1):
        rank=bisect_left(values,nums[i]);answer[i]=prefix(1-(nums[i]&1),rank);add(nums[i]&1,rank)
    return answer
